title: Lion cub with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- soft glow behind cub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='44' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- mane / fluff -->
  <g fill='#F4A02C'>
    <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='27' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='27' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='17' cy='45' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='83' cy='45' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='66' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='66' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='82' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='82' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='86' r='9'/>
  </g>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='31' r='9' fill='#E8871E'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='31' r='9' fill='#E8871E'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='31' r='4.5' fill='#FFB8A0'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='31' r='4.5' fill='#FFB8A0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='29' fill='#FFC149'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='17' ry='13' fill='#FFE3A3'/>
  <!-- eyes: big sparkly -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='39' cy='48' rx='7.5' ry='8.5' fill='#3A1E0A'/>
    <ellipse cx='61' cy='48' rx='7.5' ry='8.5' fill='#3A1E0A'/>
    <circle cx='41.5' cy='45' r='3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='63.5' cy='45' r='3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='37' cy='51' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='51' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='42' cy='50.5' r='0.9' fill='#FFF2B0'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='50.5' r='0.9' fill='#FFF2B0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M44 60 Q50 56 56 60 Q50 65 44 60 Z' fill='#B5541C'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 63 L50 67 M50 67 Q45 72 41 68 M50 67 Q55 72 59 68' fill='none' stroke='#B5541C' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='58' r='4' fill='#FF9C8A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='58' r='4' fill='#FF9C8A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <g stroke='#8A4A1A' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.9'>
    <path d='M32 62 L20 59'/>
    <path d='M32 66 L20 67'/>
    <path d='M68 62 L80 59'/>
    <path d='M68 66 L80 67'/>
  </g>
</svg>
